publication.head: codex/5527-terminal-sor-artifact-repair
publication.title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2][closeout] Repair terminal SOR artifact references
publication.body:
Closes #5527

## Summary
- add a typed, authority-scoped terminal SOR artifact-reference repair
- authenticate target record, terminal receipt, retained path, and retained bytes with exact compare-and-swap guards
- preserve atomic record/card/receipt truth with journaled rollback
- repair #5390 from its deleted diagram path to the retained terminal artifact

## Validation
- exact root-relative Gate 7 regression passes
- complete Gate 7 lifecycle suite passes (12/12)
- strict all-target Clippy, cargo fmt, and git diff checks pass
- csdlc-doctor passes for #5390 and #5527
- exact publication-head subagent review is clean

The unrelated non-Git Gate 2 fixture failures discovered by the full suite are tracked in #5548. No Runtime source changes. No AWS execution.
